items.title: Missile kills at least 52 at crowded Ukrainian train station
items.description: Ukrainian authorities say a missile hit a train station where thousands of Ukrainians had gathered. At least 52 people died in an attack on a crowd of mostly women and children trying to flee a looming Russian offensive in the country’s east.
